subject: Sunrise Therapeutics — itinerary squeeze; propose split-day demo and async deliverables
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@sunrisethera.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: scheduling@sunrisethera.com, psingh@sunrisethera.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week change — demo timing question

Hey Olga / Lauren —

Heads-up: our field team rebooked visits for the week of May 18–20. Priya will now be on-site May 19 but she has a same-day flight leaving at 6:15pm, and there’s a short layover in SFO later that day.

We still want to see Redwood in action, but our window is tight. Would you be able to condense the demo into a compact session (60 min max) focused on integrations and latency? Alternatively, split into a short live demo + recorded deep-dive we can watch en route.

Potential windows we can make: May 19, 2:30–3:30pm or May 19, 4:00–5:00pm (Priya has a gap between meetings and flight). Let me know what works.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Carter
Head of IT Operations | Sunrise Therapeutics
alex.carter@sunrisethera.com | +1 415-555-0197

Attachments: none
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@sunrisethera.com>, scheduling@sunrisethera.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week change — demo timing question

Alex — thanks for the heads-up and the windows. We can absolutely accommodate a compressed flow. Two options I'd suggest so you have flexibility during the travel day: 

Option A — Split-day (recommended):
- Morning / early afternoon: 30-min focused recorded demo covering integration points, telemetry, and latency numbers (we’ll send the recording and the supporting deck).
- May 19, 4:00–4:30pm PT: 30-min live Q&A with Priya and your tech leads to walk through any follow-ups and edge cases.

Option B — Compact live session: 60-min live demo (tight agenda; we’ll skip admin slides and jump into integration topics).

I attached a draft agenda and a mutual action plan so you can see what we’d include in the 30/60-min flows. I can own the recording + send a recording link before Priya’s flight so she can review during her layover if needed.

Proposed actions:
- If split-day works, we’ll record the 30-min demo on May 17 (or earlier) and schedule the 4:00pm PT live slot on May 19.
- If you prefer the 60-min live, confirm which of the two time windows you listed is best.

Thanks — happy to make whichever path easiest for you.

—
Olga Petrov
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai | +1 206-555-0123

Attachments: sunrise-demo-agenda.pdf, sunrise-mutual-action-plan.xlsx
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@sunrisethera.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week change — demo timing question

Adding my two cents —

If Priya only has a short window on May 19, split-day is lower risk: we control the recording quality, highlight the integration hooks (we’ll include code snippets and curl examples in the deck), and keep the live session purely for clarifying questions and next steps. We can timebox Q&A aggressively (we’ll capture any remaining questions in a shared doc).

I’ll prep a one-page summary of the performance numbers (latency med/p95, typical token throughput with batching) and include it in the Drive link so the travel team can skim during the layover.

Also — if you want, we’ll create a 15-min highlight clip from the recorded session that Priya can watch on the plane.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Thanks, all. Split-day sounds good. Priya asked for the short recorded piece + live Q&A at 4:00pm PT on May 19. If you can record the main segment earlier in the week (May 17 or 18) and share a 15–30 minute highlight clip that would be perfect.

Couple of asks for the recording:
- Call out the latency numbers for 2–3 common workflows (we’re sensitive around document ingestion + embedding throughput).
- Show the integration path for our internal S3 pipeline (we’ll send a diagram).

I’ll have scheduling push the 4:00–4:30pm invite once we confirm the recording date.

Appreciate the flexibility.
Alex

Alex / Priya / scheduling — confirmed plan: 

1) Recording: 30-min recorded demo completed May 17. We created a 15-min highlights clip and uploaded both to Drive: https://drive.google.com/sunrise-demo/agenda (link above). The full recording includes: integration walkthrough (S3 ingestion example), telemetry dashboard, and p95 latency benchmarks with/without batching.

2) Live Q&A: May 19, 4:00–4:30pm PT. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite-sunrise.ics). We’ll keep the session tight; Marcus will join to answer architecture questions.

3) Deliverables: sunrise-demo-agenda.pdf, sunrise-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (both attached), a one-pager perf summary, and the 15-min highlight clip.

Next steps for Sunrise: confirm the attendee list for the Q&A (so we can tailor examples) and upload the S3 pipeline diagram you mentioned.

Thanks — safe travels to Priya. We’ll follow up after the Q&A with a short action item list and next-steps doc in HubSpot (deal RDW-2027-0047).
